products.text:
Type: geometric lattice area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: flat-woven synthetic fibers, low pile
Colors: warm terracotta beige, cream
Shape: rectangular, interlocking hexagon and square lattice, tribal triangle bands at the ends, flat flat-woven texture, thin and light, medium-large
Feel: warm, graphic, earthy
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; modern or bohemian rooms

Type: striped wool blend area rug
Use: defining a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: wool blend, hand-tufted textured pile
Colors: light grey, charcoal
Shape: rectangular, angled panels of slanted lines meeting in chevron-like blocks, raised looped texture, medium size, plain edges
Feel: graphic, calm, textured
Goes with: cognac leather, dark wood floors, black accents; modern or mid-century rooms

Type: overdyed floral wool area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or bed area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, traditional, contemporary
Materials: wool, low tufted pile
Colors: bright pink, red, navy accents
Shape: rectangular, Persian-inspired vine and floral all-over pattern with wide border, soft low pile, medium-large
Feel: bold, vibrant, playful
Goes with: grey upholstery, dark wood, white walls, woven baskets; bohemian or eclectic rooms

Type: geometric wool runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; entryway, hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: modern, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: wool, low tufted pile
Colors: warm taupe brown, cream lines
Shape: long narrow rectangle, thin cream slanted lines forming elongated hexagon links, flat low pile, slim and light
Feel: subtle, warm, refined
Goes with: light wood floors, grey upholstery, mustard accents; modern or mid-century rooms

Type: medallion area rug
Use: anchoring an entry or seating area; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: traditional, mid-century modern, farmhouse
Materials: woven synthetic fibers, low flat pile
Colors: dark grey, ivory, light grey
Shape: rectangular, distressed central floral medallion field, ivory floral border, thin flat profile, medium small
Feel: classic, muted, timeless
Goes with: brick or wood floors, rustic wood, white walls, greenery; farmhouse or traditional rooms

Type: small striped accent rug
Use: accent mat by a counter or bed; kitchen, bedroom, entryway
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: polyester, textured shag-like pile
Colors: silver grey, white, taupe
Shape: small rectangle, irregular vertical brushstroke stripes and blocks, plush textured surface, compact and light
Feel: soft, quiet, neutral
Goes with: dark wood floors, white or grey cabinetry, brushed metal; modern rooms

Type: kilim area rug with fringe
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, rustic, traditional
Materials: flat-woven wool or cotton, fringed and tasseled ends
Colors: red, navy blue, cream, tan
Shape: rectangular, horizontal bands of diamonds and southwestern motifs, flat weave, fringe and tassels along ends, thin and light
Feel: warm, lively, earthy
Goes with: cognac leather, dark wood floors, black accents; bohemian or rustic rooms

Type: abstract spotted area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, glam
Materials: synthetic pile, soft low texture
Colors: ivory, black
Shape: rectangular, all-over small irregular black brushmark spots, light low pile, medium size, plain edges
Feel: graphic, crisp, lively
Goes with: velvet sofas, brass accents, dark walls, herringbone floors; modern or glam rooms

Type: wide striped area rug
Use: covering floor in a seating area; patio, porch, living room
Style: coastal, contemporary, modern
Materials: polyester, hooked low pile
Colors: white, emerald green, mint green
Shape: rectangular, broad green stripes edged with thin mint lines on white, smooth looped pile, flat and light
Feel: fresh, breezy, cheerful
Goes with: black benches, natural wicker, striped cushions; coastal or outdoor spaces

Type: traditional wool area rug with fringe
Use: anchoring a living or bedroom layout; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, bohemian
Materials: wool, hand-tufted low pile, multicolor fringe
Colors: warm beige, gold, light grey, ivory
Shape: large rectangle, faded Persian floral field and border, soft textured pile, fringed ends, large but visually light
Feel: warm, soft, inviting
Goes with: warm wood floors, rattan, grey upholstery; farmhouse or traditional rooms
